class.name: GenericVehicleComponentNode
class.brief_description: Where a scripted vehicle component is authored.
class.description: A component is not a node - it belongs to a vehicle, not to a scene - but a modder needs somewhere to put one and something to attach a script to. This is that place: put it under a [VehiclePhysicsNode], write [code]extends GenericVehicleComponentNode[/code], and the vehicle it sits under gets a [GenericVehicleComponent] that calls the script. The methods a script overrides are the ones [GenericVehicleComponent] declares: [code]_process_component(delta)[/code], [code]_get_component_state()[/code], [code]_get_component_config()[/code].

method.name: get_component
method.description: The component this node put into the vehicle, for anything that wants it directly.

method.name: get_controller
method.description: The vehicle the component belongs to - a shortcut to the component's own.

method.name: log_debug
method.description: Writes [param line] to the game log at the debug level, as the component.

method.name: log_warning
method.description: Writes [param line] to the game log at the warning level, as the component.

method.name: register_command
method.description: The vehicle answers [param command] by calling [param callable] - a shortcut to the component's own.

method.name: unregister_command
method.description: The vehicle no longer answers [param command] - a shortcut to the component's own.
